description:
Hushfeed v0.67.0 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

TikTok's "Videos you might like" pushes are blocked from the first launch, with a switch under Inbox to let them back. New patches keep new searches out of your history, give feed descriptions and creator names their own text sizes, and hide the shortcuts under a profile's bio. The LIVE feed can be filtered, TikTok's phone benchmark can be stopped, streaks take several people, and the settings come in Azerbaijani.

Comments, the author region and long press actions follow the video on screen, the music line hides its song credit, share sheet exclusions stay put, and photo posts save as their original images. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2733 runtime tests passed and 533 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The music line, share sheet exclusions and photo saves were checked on a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
